title: Dittert–Hajek conjecture
exact_target: Among nonnegative square matrices whose entries sum to the size of the matrix, prove that the Dittert functional has its unique maximum at the constant matrix.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 3200002 (AMR-031-0002). CC BY 4.0.
Divya K. U. and K. Somasundaram, Lih Wang and Dittert’s Conjectures on Permanents (2023), §1, pp.1–4.
